ModMetaData.name: HSK Tactical AI
ModMetaData.author: Sonsalt
ModMetaData.description:
A custom raid AI for Hardcore SK (0.3, test release).
Raiders plan their attack instead of walking into your guns: - Threat map: they know where your colonists and turrets can shoot (toggle the overlay with the crosshair button, bottom-right bar). - Killboxes and funnels: they avoid them and make their own way in, breaching several walls at once with charges, launchers, breach tools, fire, grenades on doors, or tunnels through rock. - Open ground: they take a covered route, rush only with 3:1 odds or behind smoke, flank, or snipe from out of range and leave when an attack is bound to fail. - Combined arms: base of fire (machine guns, snipers) pins your defenders while the assault moves; overwatch on the breach; shield bearers lead and throw grenades; medics pull the wounded out; fire and movement inside each group; groups arrive together from several sides. - Fire discipline: aimed or snap shots, single, short bursts or full auto by range and role; realistic suppression (machine guns and explosives pin, armour does not stop the flinch). - Gas and fire against bunkers, arson, plunder (loot, livestock, wrecking) instead of chasing you into your corridors, planned withdrawals carrying the wounded, going prone under fire. - Tactical competence: how smart a raid acts depends on its leader's intelligence (Intellectual skill, traits like too smart or slow learner) and its faction's tech level. A sharp spacer commander uses every tactic and walks around your traps and IEDs; a dull tribal chief walks straight into your killbox and traps. Kill the leader and the raid loses its edge. - Raid goals: a raid out to break in always brings breaching gear of its tech level (breach axe, stick bombs, charges). Some raids only scout your base from cover, others sabotage: fires, livestock, a colonist alone outside - and leave before your defence turns out. - Adapting: defenders who come out are fought where they are, a defence beaten in the field is stormed at once. Grenadiers lob explosive rounds over your walls; bigger raids carry a crew-served gun, set it up near its full range and man it before the assault, and pack it up or wreck it when they leave - loot only if the crew falls. Riflemen cover comrades who carry the wounded out of your fire, and raiders react when a colonist steps into sight. Tribal and medieval sieges get their supplies by pack animal. - Raid memory: factions learn from survivors and from prisoners who got away. They pick a quieter edge to come in from, or drop pods (spacers); a beaten faction comes back bigger and sometimes for revenge (takes nothing, does not break off); some raids come for people (slavers grab a downed colonist and leave). Sharp commands run operations: hammer and anvil (a siege group shells while the rest waits out of range) or an armoured spearhead. The raid letter says why.
Every behaviour can be switched off in the mod settings.
Works with Smarter Raid AI, Combat Extended and Enemy Self Preservation. Not with CAI 5000 or Raid Tactics (they change the same raid AI; this mod has its own raid memory).
